webhooks.detail: Only Google Ads lead form webhook (CRM) pushes lead data to your URL. No general event/change subscriptions in Google Ads API; polling (search/change events) needed.

evidence.quote: The webhook CRM solution lets you configure a URL path, which we then use to send all incoming lead data from the ad.

sandbox.detail: Test accounts: free, don't affect live ads or charge; need a manager account and developer token (test accounts work with test-level token). Deleted after 1 year inactive.

evidence.quote: Test accounts don't affect your live ads or charge your account.

rate_limits.summary: QPS limits per customer ID and per Cloud project; exact value varies with server load; exceeded -> RESOURCE_TEMPORARILY_EXHAUSTED

evidence.quote: enforces rate limiting by queries per second (QPS) on both customer IDs and Google Cloud projects independently
